# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security problems.

Email **[contact@nocleye.com](mailto:contact@nocleye.com)** with:

- the affected version,
- a description of the issue and its impact,
- steps or a config to reproduce it.

We will acknowledge your report and keep you updated while we work on a fix.

## Supported versions

The gateway is in beta. Only the latest beta release receives security fixes.
